What's new in 1.7.0

Five professional templates
- Annual Report: your year as a shareholder report, with a serif cover, key figures that roll into place like an odometer, a monthly bar chart and your languages as a portfolio.
- Ticker: your year as a listed stock, with weekly candlesticks of your activity, a ticker symbol from your username (or your own) and a scrolling tape of your repos.
- Intaglio: an engraved certificate in the manner of a banknote, with a fine-line medallion drawn from your year, your name in engraved capitals and a seal that stamps down.
- Departures: a split-flap departures board where every letter flips into place. Your projects are the flights, and what you're working on now is boarding.
- Swiss: a Swiss-style typographic poster with a strict grid, one red and your contributions set as an oversized figure.

Made for founders, executives and senior engineers
- Each new template has fields for your title and organisation. Annual Report also lists up to three highlights.
- Your name, role and projects stay as plain text, and every number comes from your public GitHub activity.
- Each has its own themed GitHub Sponsors page.
- Search "Professional" on the Templates page to see all five.
